name: visual_shape_protocol_3x5_heldout_20261029
target_pairing: Within each learning round all seven visual conditions share the same 50 source tasks. Each round resamples; GD/CEM share identical inputs. All evaluation methods and Ours chains share the same held-out tasks per test seed.
frozen_implementation: Official README equivalent: per-episode AdaJEPA planner with adapt.steps=0 and adapt.lr=0; full parameters and buffers verified unchanged.
adajepa_implementation: AdaJEPAMPCPlanner, one-step last-predictor-layer and encoder-head adaptation, reset before every episode. No continual memory.
saves: per-step logs, per-episode audit, actions, initial/goal states; no videos or persistent adapted checkpoints
comparison_scope: v6a uses pushobj_T16k_bias_e3; AdaJEPA and frozen use official visual checkpoint. This is a comparison across checkpoint conditions, not a same-checkpoint method ablation.
state_policy: Each of six GD/CEM learning chains starts empty and inherits across all 35 ordered blocks. Preserve round-end states locally and all final states; reclaim transition states only after successor audit.
seed_policy: Set evaluation/planning seed for each round; reuse that seed for its seven domain processes. Keep internal v6a replay sampler and probe seed at their unchanged original value 0.
storage_policy: Keep complete actions, initial/goals, per-episode/step/loss/library logs. Compress target images losslessly. Back up each completed batch; retain round-end/final library states. Stop before low disk or unbacked round-state accumulation.
sampling_policy: Learning: random.Random(round_seed).sample(range(1000),50), matching shape seed-stream builder. Tests: seeded shuffle after excluding every learning source ep_idx, select 50 unique ep_idx per seed; no test source ep_idx repeats across test seeds.
test_policy: Read-only round-5 library with normal within-episode fast adaptation and learner reading; no persistent training, writes, merging, replay, maturity updates, or test-state carry. Frozen uses batched SlowFrozenMPCPlanner. AdaJEPA adapts and resets independently each episode.
statistics_policy: Final success/MPC metrics from held-out test only. Mean and sample standard deviation over test seeds; pool three Ours chains within each test-seed block. Learning curves separate.
